map.阻燃等级数字越小越好？: Is a smaller flame-retardant number better?
map.是的，本工具取 1=A 不燃、2=B1 难燃、3=B2 可燃、4=B3 易燃，≤: Yes — this tool maps 1=A non-combustible, 2=B1, 3=B2, 4=B3; ≤2 means B1 and above pass. Class A is best; B3 is forbidden for building insulation.
map.三项都合格就绝对安全？: Are all three passing absolutely safe?
